description: This file implements the PSR-7 UriInterface, providing a class for URI manipulation, parsing, and string serialization including methods for constructing and validating URIs.

classes.name: Uri
classes.description: A comprehensive implementation of the PSR-7 UriInterface, allowing URI creation, modification, parsing, validation, and serialization, used within Guzzle HTTP client library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the URI object, optionally parsing a given URI string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the URI to its string representation, composing it from individual components.

methods.name: composeComponents
methods.description: Builds a URI string from parts: scheme, authority, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: isDefaultPort
methods.description: Checks if the URI is using the default port for its scheme.

methods.name: isAbsolute
methods.description: Determines if the URI is absolute (has a scheme).

methods.name: isNetworkPathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a network-path reference (starts with //).

methods.name: isAbsolutePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is an absolute-path reference (starts with /).

methods.name: isRelativePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a relative-path reference.

methods.name: isSameDocumentReference
methods.description: Determines if two URIs refer to the same document, optionally relative to a base URI.

methods.name: withoutQueryValue
methods.description: Returns a new URI with a specific query parameter removed.

methods.name: withQueryValue
methods.description: Returns a new URI with a specific query parameter set or replaced.

methods.name: withQueryValues
methods.description: Returns a new URI with multiple query parameters set or replaced.

methods.name: fromParts
methods.description: Creates a URI object from an array of parse_url components.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the URI scheme.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Returns the URI authority component (user info, host, port).

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Returns the user info component.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port component or null.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path component.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the query string.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new URI with the specified scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new URI with specified user info (and password).

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new URI with specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new URI with specified port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new URI with specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new URI with specified query string.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new URI with specified fragment.
